links.outcome: LLM classifier performance differences by patient sex and insurance type
links.effect: Analyses revealed no model bias in relation to patient sex or insurance. Overall sensitivity 87.2, specificity 86.3, AUC 0.93 on holdout test set.
links.quote: Analyses revealed no model bias in relation to patient sex or insurance.

unlisted_practices: Using an LLM to measure clinician guideline adherence and quality of care from clinical notes
Training and testing an LLM on both in-clinic/telehealth and telephone encounter notes

screen.reason: The study validates the retrospective accuracy and bias of an LLM (LLaMA) in auditing electronic health record notes for ADHD medication side effect monitoring quality metrics, but it does not test a deployment practice or safeguard.
